summary: No actionable correctness blocker found in xswap-fast-in unified swapin engine. Allocator-first sync swapin in mm/memory.c and mm/swap_state.c eliminates redundant cache lookups, single-lock allocation halves cluster spinlock acquisitions for order-0 demand faults, adaptive stride streak-gating collapses readahead window on non-contiguous access, and decoupled async zswap prefetch unblocks the faulting thread while decompressing speculative slots in the background. All 4 prior defects resolved; checkpatch clean with 0 errors and 0 warnings.
